Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3092); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite:--Josaphat.
BiblicalUsage: Josaphat is the Greek form of Jehoshaphat, the king who sought the Lord, and Matthew names him in the genealogy. In Matthew 1:8 Asa begat Josaphat, and Josaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Ozias, in the line of the kings from Abraham to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Josaphat's name in the list is a bright spot among the kings: a man who set his heart to seek God, and whose son's line God kept.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Joram, Son of Jehoshaphat
